title: GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON – official event homepage
claims: The official homepage gives 42.195 kilometres as the race distance.
The 2026 men's winner was Guye Adola (ETH) in 2:02:50 and the women's winner was Tigst Assefa (ETH) in 2:11:04.
The first German man was Haftom Welday in 2:08:25 and the first German woman was Anna Langerwisch in 2:27:31.
The 2026 men's race-wheelchair winner was Marcel Hug (SUI) in 1:23:28 and the women's race-wheelchair winner was Catherine Debrunner (SUI) in 1:35:01.
The first GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON will take place on 26 September 2027, after Generali becomes title partner on 1 October 2026.
The homepage links to the 2026 results at berlin.r.mikatiming.com/2026.
